about.title: More than a job title.
about.intro: A software specialist with a researcher’s curiosity and a builder’s mindset.
about.body: I work across front-end engineering, connected devices, and applied research. My experience spans industry, academia, and R&D, with a particular interest in making complex systems useful to people. Teaching and learning are part of how I work, every day.

work.medlifeIntro: As founder and indie developer of MedLife, I worked across hardware, secure communication, mobile applications, and AI services. January–September 2025, Tehran.
layerDescriptions: PCB design, C, FreeRTOS, and Raspberry Pi Pico 1 hardware.
Cross-platform ECDH key exchange and ChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption.
Flask API microservices, mobile health, and patient–clinician vital-sign monitoring.
XGBoost health-risk classification and MedLLaMA-2.0 7B inference.
